cloudOff.name: worktree_remove
cloudOff.description: Takes away the worktree wsp made for the branch, with git: refused while a thread is working in it, and over files no commit holds unless force, which loses them. The branch itself stays, and a detached worktree's commit is kept under refs/rescue. A worktree the person or an agent made is never removed; threads that ran in a removed worktree go on in the project folder.

project.description: the project, by the name or the id projects lists

force.description: remove it over files no commit holds, which go with it
